decisions.reason: The air-cooled condenser was moved up to a page of its own in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and keeping a product so close to the core offer costs little.
Like B, it now has a dedicated page and sits close to the established condenser business, so the option is worth more open than closed.
The tube liner is a low-cost service add-on that supports the lifecycle-service strategy, and its value is still uncertain, so keeping the option open is justified.
The customized air cooler line is close to the core offer and engineered to order, so carrying it costs little while demand across several models is still being revealed.
The tube end repair inserts fit the service and repair business at minimal holding cost, and nothing so far shows their value is unlikely to be realized.
